strong_novelty_candidates: Exact-Q Rational Polytope Certificates and Cuboctahedral Supremacy in Quantum Steering
Zero-Dependency Lean 4 Formalization of Finite-Setting Steering Gap Laws and Superactivation
summary: The paper presents exact rational algebra, zero-dependency Lean 4 formalization (18 theorems), and pure-stdlib verification (EPR-STEER-CERT-1.0) for universal finite-m steering gap laws, exact-Q polytope duality (cuboctahedral supremacy), and unconditional two-copy superactivation of PVM-critical two-qubit states strictly below criticality.
weaknesses: Exhaustive sign-pattern verification scales as O(2^{m-1}), making larger m >= 20 computationally demanding without symmetry-orbit reduction.
Two-copy superactivation witness uses maximally entangled Bell measurement (t = s = 1) rather than arbitrarily weak entanglement.
